title: Themes and place
question: Do the themes people name in an account depend on where the account was recorded?

settings.name: sample_size
settings.label: Accounts read
settings.note: Every account costs two readings and one judgement per theme. Twelve is a few minutes on a real model; fifty is an hour.

settings.name: pairs_per_round
settings.label: Pairs per round
settings.note: How many of the most promising theme pairs to ask about before giving up on a round. The original stops after a hundred rejections; ten is the toy's version of that.

types.account: one account of an experience in nature, as it was written

draft.about: one free-form reading of one account

types.verdict: whether one theme appears in one account
types.row: one account, judged against every theme
types.site: the setting an account was recorded in
types.judgement: whether two themes are the same concept, and the wording to keep

chart.title: How often each theme appears, by setting
chart.note: Two accounts have no site record and drop out at the join.
